dashboard.label: Customer Example — Overview
dashboard.description: Nine pain points captured in a customer discovery workshop, each turned into a dashboard: a worked example plus the data sources needed to build it for real.

html.p: This app is built from a single discovery conversation with a hospital IT team. Every dashboard below answers one thing they said, with a quick worked example (built from representative sample data, since these source systems aren't part of this lab) and a plain list of the data sources Splunk would actually ingest to solve it for real. Use it as a talk track, not a finished build.

Nothing here is connected to the customer's real DHCP server, ISE, DNA Center, NSX Manager, bed-management system, or LLM platform — those don't exist in this lab. Every chart is generated on the fly with makeresults so the story renders with zero setup; swap it for the real search once the data source is onboarded.

panel.title: The nine use cases, at a glance

tr.td: X-ray machine went down after its IP silently flipped from static to DHCP — long root-cause hunt.
Detect + alert on unexpected DHCP lease changes for critical/reserved assets.
DHCP server logs, CMDB/asset inventory, switch port/CDP logs, ISE
Redundant DB servers are barely monitored; nobody knows why failover triggered.
Correlate cluster/replication events with host + network heartbeat around the failover.
DB/cluster logs, OS metrics, VIP/heartbeat network logs
IoT is 99% reactive; managed by an external provider.
Shift to proactive: connectivity/battery trend + predictive alerting, shared with the MSP.
IoT gateway/MQTT telemetry, wireless/VLAN logs, MSP ticketing API
No correlation across ISE, DNA Center and the rest of the network stack.
One timeline: auth events (ISE) + client/network health (DNAC) + interface state (switches).
Cisco ISE, Cisco DNA Center, switch/router syslog & SNMP, WLC
A label printer failed this year from rising temperatures.
Correlate device error codes with room/ambient temperature trend to predict/prevent it.
Environmental (BMS/IoT) sensors, printer/device SNMP logs, asset location
VMware/NSX microsegmentation — "one small click and the other side stops working again" when the vendor moves a port.
Correlate DFW/firewall rule + port-group changes with the connectivity break that follows.
NSX Manager (DFW rule changes), vCenter events, change management/CMDB
Bed occupancy monitoring — potentially interesting for GL (leadership).
Executive KPI view: occupancy % by ward, trend, and a simple forecast.
Bed management / RTLS system, ADT (HL7) feed, nurse call system
"Solange es in der Schweiz verarbeitet wird, darf es auch in die Cloud raus."
Prove data-residency compliance on every cloud egress, flag anything processed outside CH.
Proxy/CASB logs, DLP/data-classification tags, cloud provider audit logs (with region)
AI Observability is interesting, but leadership has the handbrake on due to uncertainty.
Governance-first view: cost/latency plus guardrail & DLP hits, to de-risk before scaling up.
LLM/API gateway logs, model registry, guardrail/DLP scan logs, identity
